title: Seven Winter in Tehran (GFF)
synopsis:
Tehran, July 2007: Reyhaneh Jabbari, 19, has a business meeting with a new client. When he tries to rape her, she stabs him in self-defense. Later that day, she is arrested for murder. Her trial results in a death penalty sentence. Thanks to personal and secretly recorded videos provided by Reyhaneh's family, their testimonies and the letters written by Reyhaneh in prison, the ﬁlm retraces the fate of a woman who becomes a symbol of resistance and women's rights even beyond the borders of Iran.

 

2023     Compass-Perspektive Award, Berlinale

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
伊朗女性命運向來備受關注，她們所受的不公平對待及慘況更是駭人聽聞。2007年7月，德黑蘭。19歲少女 Reyhaneh Jabbari 在工作時險遭強姦，她出於自衛還擊卻被控謀殺，得到的竟是死刑判決。法庭要求她更改口供並承認控罪換取減刑，被她毅然拒絕。繫獄七年，Reyhaneh 的家人四處奔走希望為她討回公道，無奈最終徒勞無功，Reyhaneh 在2014年被處決。導演 Steffi Niederzoll 以身犯險，透過珍貴的錄影片段、家屬的證言及 Reyhaneh 在獄中所寫的信件，凸顯她無懼強權的不屈意志。這些信件更由《聖誅》演員 Zar Amir Ebrahimi 讀出，發揚少女的堅毅精神。

 

2023     柏林影展羅盤視角獎
